title: The stack deploy scripts can run a second, prefixed compose stack on one host while every master command stays byte-identical
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the three test files named in run.cmd.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the named tests.
expect: With no flag and no variable, deploy-tracy-stack.sh, check-server.sh and deploy-host-dsh.sh ask docker compose exactly what they asked before (no -p, the same -f files, the same env file).
compose.server.yml and host-dsh.yml render and hash identically for the master whether or not the new variables are exported with their default values.

--project / TRACY_COMPOSE_PROJECT (app stack) and --project / HOST_DSH_PROJECT (dsh) add -p to every compose call; TRACY_STACK_EXTRA_FILES adds one -f per entry; a missing extra file stops before anything changes.
A project or a non-default dsh container with the master env file is refused with exit 2 before any docker call; invalid project and container names are refused the same way.
The rollback hint is the old text with every default and a complete re-runnable command otherwise.
fence: The compose argument set, env_file and dsh network interpolation, project flag, extra files and guards of the three stack scripts; master defaults unchanged

tests: golden: with no flag and no variable the compose argv are the origin/develop ones
--project tracy-d1: every compose call carries -p, the env file is unchanged
TRACY_STACK_EXTRA_FILES adds one -f per entry, after the two base files, on every call
a missing extra file stops the deploy by name before anything is pulled or written
--project with the default env file is refused (exit 2) before any docker call
golden: the same-tag path asks compose exactly what it asked before
HOST_DSH_PROJECT works and the flag beats it
a second dsh started with --env-file gets its own file in what compose sees
what a master deploy now exports changes nothing: render and config hashes are identical
golden: with no flag and no variable the compose argv and the container names are the literals
--project tracy-d1: every compose call carries -p; the container names follow the variables (TD.11)
TD.9: HOST_DSH_CONTAINER is the container the health wait, smoke test and image check ask about
